quests.question: This person drives a big truck that pushes snow off the road.
quests.hint: This person drives a big truck that pushes snow off the road.
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a snow plow driver. Snow plow drivers clear snow from roads after a snowstorm.
quests.funFact: Snow plow drivers help keep everyone safe on icy, snowy roads.
quests.wordExample: The snow plow driver pushed the snow off to the side.

quests.question: This person teaches people how to ride ocean waves on a surfboard.
quests.hint: This person teaches people how to ride ocean waves on a surfboard.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a surf instructor. Surf instructors teach people how to ride ocean waves on a surfboard.
quests.funFact: A surf instructor teaches beginners to catch small, gentle waves first!
quests.wordExample: The surf instructor helped me stand up on the board.

quests.question: This person draws the plan for a building before it is built.
quests.hint: This person draws the plan for a building before it is built.
quests.explanation: You got it! This is an architect. Architects design buildings before workers start to build them.

quests.question: This person works early in the morning to clear snowy streets.
